tasks.objective: List every Rust source file containing ASH_FAULT, one normalized relative path per line in byte order.

linux.script: find src -type f -name '*.rs' -exec grep -l 'ASH_FAULT' {} + | LC_ALL=C sort

macos.script: find src -type f -name '*.rs' -exec grep -l 'ASH_FAULT' {} + | LC_ALL=C sort

windows.script: $root = (Get-Location).Path.TrimEnd('\') + '\'; Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath src -Recurse -File -Filter *.rs | Where-Object { Select-String -LiteralPath $_.FullName -SimpleMatch 'ASH_FAULT' -Quiet } | ForEach-Object { $_.FullName.Substring($root.Length).Replace('\', '/') } | Sort-Object -CaseSensitive | ForEach-Object { [Console]::Out.WriteLine($_) }

tasks.objective: Count each error code in build.log and output CODE COUNT sorted by code.

linux.script: grep '^error E[0-9][0-9][0-9]:' build.log | sed 's/^error \([^:]*\):.*/\1/' | LC_ALL=C sort | uniq -c | awk '{print $2 " " $1}'

macos.script: grep '^error E[0-9][0-9][0-9]:' build.log | sed 's/^error \([^:]*\):.*/\1/' | LC_ALL=C sort | uniq -c | awk '{print $2 " " $1}'

windows.script: Select-String -LiteralPath build.log -Pattern '^error (E[0-9]{3}):' | ForEach-Object { $_.Matches[0].Groups[1].Value } | Group-Object | Sort-Object Name | ForEach-Object { [Console]::Out.WriteLine("$($_.Name) $($_.Count)") }

tasks.objective: Set engine workers to 8 without changing io_workers or any other file.

windows.script: $path = (Resolve-Path 'config/ash.toml').Path; $value = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($path); if ($value -notmatch '(?m)^workers = 2$') { throw 'missing worker setting' }; $value = [Text.RegularExpressions.Regex]::Replace($value, '(?m)^workers = 2$', 'workers = 8'); $utf8 = New-Object Text.UTF8Encoding($false); [IO.File]::WriteAllText($path, $value, $utf8)
